scripts.build: postcss src/index.css -o dist/index.css && postcss 'src/*.css' -d dist && postcss 'src/accent/*.css' -d dist/accent && postcss 'src/gray/*.css' -d dist/gray && postcss 'src/hosts/*.css' -d dist/hosts
scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; postcss src/index.css -o dist/index.css --watch & postcss 'src/*.css' -d dist --watch & postcss 'src/accent/*.css' -d dist/accent --watch & postcss 'src/gray/*.css' -d dist/gray --watch & postcss 'src/hosts/*.css' -d dist/hosts --watch & wait
